versions.content: Specification of Basic Software Mode Manager AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 76 of 162 Document ID 313 : AUTOSAR_SWS_BSWModeManager If the BswMDevErrorDetect switch is enabled , the routine shall check if the BSW M ode Manager is initialized. If the BswM - mainfunction is uninitialized called from the BSW Scheduler, then it shall return immediately without performing any action and without reporting an error.
